title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I got married in 2008 and we have 2 children (26 months and 12 months). I want to get permanent separation from my wife by divorce 1671 views Q. After marriage at my husband house i was treated very badly by him and by his mother and sisters his mother also involved in "sifli" she usually drop dirty water in food also put her nails and dirt of her body in cooked food she usually wash her foots and that water used in drinking water my husband didnot do any thing to stop her my husnabd want me to get closer to his own elder brother and his brother infront of him done bad things with me it was quite difficult for me to live there I had left his house since seven years back from that time i m living in my mothers house with my two kids I am earning for my kids my husband was not taking care for us since then seven years have been passed he dont even know what we are doing for living i have applied for Fasq in Darulqaza one year back they have sent three notices to him but he didnot reply one complete year have been passed please tell me what to do ?can u please tell me that a women in Islam do not have any choice or self respect. 1914 views Q. I hope Insha Allah, you will be able to advice in the right direction. Please look into the following case: One Mrs. XYZ sought Khul from her husband Mr. ABC after eight years of marital life. Mr. ABC approved the request for Khul of Mrs. XYZ and Khul took place. Before the Idda period was over, the woman XYZ realized her fault and requested again for Nikkah, which the man ABC has accepted. They got remarried as per the Islamic Sharia. Within 3 months of remarriage, the Husband Mr. ABC realized and warned her that she is not obedient and not behaving properly as a wife. Finally after a few days, the Husband ABC divorced her (XYZ) during Tohar condition one time for not fulfilling the marital requirements. Before the Idda period came to an end, the wife repented and they reconciled and got united again. Again after 5 months, Husband ABC divorced Mrs. XYZ for her not obedient attitude and for not fulfilling the marital requirements. Again the wife Mrs. XYZ said, she will try to be following the marital requirements of a wife and they got reunited again. Again after reunification, the same problems surfaced again. Now the husband wants to diverse her again. Now the question is if the Husband divorces now in Tohar condition, is it considered as first Talaq, or the Third talaq? 2101 views Q. Talaq 4443 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 62485 Country: India Title: talaq masala Question: I had been staying in Qatar with my family including 2 kids for 8 years. There was always dispute, fighting and abuse which started after 3 years of my marriage. I had been tolerating this situation for 10 years and my stamina become very week which resulted in a form of mental problem and even now I am under treatment. My wife also have mental problem and she is also under treatment in India. I came India with my family and I was very sick and I was sure that if my wife will go to Qatar with me, it will be very disastrous for me. There was no way to stop her except conditional talaq which I applied saying to my wife that "Agar ab tum qatar jaogi to tumhara talaq ho jayega". Since then she has been staying in India for last 2 years and I am here in Qatar with my both kids as they are studying here. I was so depressed hence my intention was to stop her from going to Qatar forever. Could you please tell me in the light of Quran and Hadith whether I could bring her again to Qatar or not. Answer ID: 62485 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 111/111/SD=03/1437) In the question mentioned above, after you had uttered conditional words if your wife travels to Qatar she will be divorced with rajai talaq in which you will have the option to take her back within the iddah period: قال المرغيناني: وإذا أضافه إلى الشرط وقع عقيب الشرط اتفاقاً .. (الفتاوى الهندية: 1/488، الفصل الثالث في تعليق الطلاق بكلمة إن وإذا وغيرها ، ط: مكتبة الاتحاد ، ديوبند، وكذا في الهداية: 2/385 ، باب الأيمان في الطلاق) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
